to rush, to hasten
to rush, to hasten

On the forms of this verb, see Thes. vol. 7 p. 148 and Veitch p. 518. Aeschylus used only the aorist σύθην [I rushed], without the augment, and the participles συθείς [having rushed] and σύμενος [rushing].
Another form of the verb is σοῦσθαι [to rush]; on which see under σοῦμαι.
